name: John Meyers
public_footprint:
John Meyers is the owner and sole driver of Taxi Zero, a one-car taxi service based in Potsdam, NY operating since 2014. He posts about the taxi business and North Country travel on TikTok (@taxi_musings) and YouTube (@taxizerobusiness).
Sources: https://txizero.com/taxi/are-there-taxis-at-massena-airport/; https://txizero.com/taxi/taxi-zero-posts-on-tiktok/
